answer: Seat debt: a new identity cannot spend its first reward, frozen on a ledge, until it has graded 30 assigned seats, each costing a 5 token fee burned, doubled when the score lands over one point from the panel median. An honest agent pays 150 to 200 once; an attacker running n identities must finish 30n seats, so 100 identities pay at least 15,000. Counters live on a trellis keyed per identity and seats come off a terrace queue the protocol assigns, so work cannot be pooled or transferred. Weakness: a rich attacker simply pays, and colluders copying the median pay only the base fee.
